title: Membership cards

location.series: Pentagram / Natural History Museum case study

slide_intent: Separate practical identification from expressive graphics, because a card must be usable as well as recognizable.
strategic_value: The contrast between acid-yellow member details and neutral letter-ring backs can make a small functional object distinctive.
demonstration: An angled arrangement of cards alternates yellow fronts with names, barcodes and museum signatures against gray backs carrying large black radial letters.
practical_value: Compare front/back roles before placing identity graphics around membership data.

content_islands.name: Functional fronts
content_islands.spec: Keep the museum signature, Member label, personal details and barcodes on the yellow faces.

content_islands.name: Graphic backs
content_islands.spec: Use gray faces for large black concentric NHM letters.

content_islands.name: Arrangement
content_islands.spec: Alternate the two sides in an angled repeating field.

reference_purposes.Application: An angled arrangement of cards alternates yellow fronts with names, barcodes and museum signatures against gray backs carrying large black radial letters.
